headline: Generative models span peptide, TCR, binder, antibody and PROTAC design
label: Generative Protein Design Models
summary: Recent preprints pair conditional generators across peptides, TCRs, antibodies, and PROTACs with interpretability and structured readouts.
synthesis: The dominant thread is conditional generative modeling of biomolecular sequences, with diffusion, autoregressive, and adversarial generators steered by target context. TCRDiff conditions CDR3β generation on pMHC and TRBV inputs and reports in vitro MAGE-A3 recognition; NT-ABDiff jointly generates antibody CDR sequence and structure while reweighting noisy templates. PepALD applies autoregressive latent diffusion to macrocyclic peptides, and AMPGAN v3 uses two discriminators to produce D-amino acid antimicrobial peptides. Interpretability and interface analysis form a secondary layer: ProGenMech applies cross-layer transcoders to ProGen3, and PepLLM generates structured JSON annotations of protein-peptide interfaces. The aptamer study and LOGICA address adjacent nucleic acid and cross-modal problems, so the thread is not uniform. What is new is the pairing of explicit conditioning with mechanistic or structured readouts in one pipeline.
